October brings crisp air and vibrant autumn colors to Newtown. From the historic flagpole on Main Street and the grounds of Edmond Town Hall to the expansive walking paths at Fairfield Hills, there is plenty of open space to enjoy. Outdoor recreation options include hiking at Holcombe Hill Wildlife Preserve, exploring trails in Paugussett State Forest, and accessing boating areas along Lake Zoar and Lake Lillinonah. Downtown features independent restaurants, local shops, and cultural gatherings throughout the fall season. Route 25 and Interstate 84 provide regional connections across Fairfield County and beyond. Downtown Danbury offers local dining, cultural venues, and seasonal gatherings, while Richter Park provides public golf and walking paths against scenic fall backdrops. Getting around the region is straightforward with access to Interstate 84, Route 7, and the Danbury Metro-North train station connecting south toward Norwalk and New York City. If you are touring homes in New Milford this October, your inspection checklist deserves close attention. Many properties throughout the area rely on private wells and septic systems. Autumn is the time to schedule comprehensive flow and water potability tests, along with a full septic inspection, while the ground remains accessible and workable. It is also wise to have a qualified professional inspect the heating equipment, chimney, and roof flashing before freezing temperatures set in. Understanding the age and condition of these essential mechanicals gives you clear insight into upcoming maintenance needs before you finalize your purchase.
